title: The Sabbat strike on Atlanta
summary: Part of the Sabbat drive up the East Coast.

claims.text: Atlanta’s fall was part of a Sabbat push for supremacy on the continent; elite legionnaires hand-chosen by a Sabbat cardinal took part, and Sabbat packs attacked the city’s Kindred openly with no care for the Masquerade.

title: Atlanta Before the Fall
summary: Atlanta's Kindred before the Sabbat took the city.

claims.text: The novel The Fall of Atlanta tells that Prince Benison ruled Atlanta before the city fell, and that the city police were under the prince's control.
The same novel tells that Atlanta's elders were at war with the city's anarchs, who followed the Brujah Thelonious and the Ventrue Benjamin, whose sire Eleanor was the prince's wife.
